verdict.rationale: The product's own docs say Business Online Services and Web File let users schedule payments in advance, which is a narrow, first-party form of scheduled execution. Nothing shows recurrence, general workflow automation, or any API/programmatic surface for an AI-native user: the OpenAPI probes returned 404 and the /e-services/ transaction paths are robots-disallowed. Missing for 10: recurring (repeat-cadence) schedules, scheduling of jobs beyond one-off payments, programmatic/API access to scheduling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
